images.alt_en: Mourners prepare iron discs and blue glass bells on opposite sides of the memorial axle.
images.alt_sl: Žalujoči pripravljajo železne diske in modre steklene zvončke na obeh straneh spominske osi.

images.alt_en: Illuminara braces the damaged axle as a mourner touches the cracked memorial panel.
images.alt_sl: Illuminara zadržuje poškodovano os, žalujoča pa se dotika počene spominske plošče.

images.alt_en: Mourners hold memorial discs and bells as the chamber turns and droplets float.
images.alt_sl: Žalujoči držijo spominske diske in zvončke, ko se dvorana obrača in kapljice obvisijo v zraku.
